items.q: Do I need a medical card to purchase?
items.a: No! We are a recreational dispensary. Any adult 21 years of age or older with a valid, non-expired government-issued ID (state ID, driver's license, or passport) can purchase from us.

items.q: What forms of payment do you accept?
items.a: We accept cash and debit cards in-store. We also accept Dutchie Pay (an ACH payment system) for online orders and delivery. We have an ATM on site for your convenience.

items.q: How much cannabis can I buy at once?
items.a: Under New Jersey law, recreational customers can purchase up to 1 ounce of usable cannabis (or the equivalent in other products) per transaction. This equals 1 ounce of flower, 1,000mg of edibles, or 1,000mg (1 gram) of concentrates.

Yes! We offer free delivery to the Irvington area and surrounding Essex County on orders over $60. Orders under $60 are subject to an $11 delivery fee. Deliveries must be paid via Dutchie Pay (ACH) prior to arrival. The person who placed the order must be present with valid ID to receive the delivery.
